extensionDescription.message: Lightweight right-to-left Hebrew support for Slack.

languageCode.description: Language tag of this translation, set as the options page's lang.

textDirection.description: Text direction of this translation, ltr or rtl, set as the options page's dir.

alignmentAutoDescription.message: Each line aligns to its own side: right-to-left lines on the right, left-to-right lines on the left.

alignmentLeftDescription.message: Hebrew and other right-to-left lines keep their reading direction but line up on the left edge, like the rest of Slack's text.
